Set 1:
Seven friends (Alice, Bob, Charlie, David, Eve, Frank, Grace) have meetings on different days of the week (Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday). Based on the following clues, can you figure out who has a meeting on which day?
1. Alice has a meeting the day before Charlie.
2. Bob has a meeting sometime after Eve.
3. David does not have a meeting on Sunday or Monday.
4. Eve has a meeting the day after Alice.
5. Charlie has a meeting on Wednesday.
6. Frank has a meeting the day before Grace.
7. Grace does not have a meeting on Saturday.

Who has a meeting on Sunday?
